notes: Posted 29 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine. The post says this is his pre-Tatooine deck (the 'post-Reflections 2 form'), retired because of Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'STARTING (8)': Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe ('Hunt Down'), Executor: Holotheatre ('Holotheater'), Executor: Meditation Chamber ('Med Chamber'), Visage Of The Emperor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points and Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the 60. Visage Of The Emperor is the starting Effect the Objective deploys.
Visage Of The Emperor is listed twice, once in STARTING and again in EFFECTS (9); the post's running totals ('[TOTAL CARDS = 34]') count both, so both are kept as published. Total 60 as published.
The 'Vader's Retirement Party' line at the top of the list (the deck title) and the '[TOTAL CARDS = N]' running-total lines are not cards.

Posted 'Admiral Cheerios' dested Admiral Chiraneau (the strategy: 'I can't ever remember the guy's name ... I can't pronounce it'); 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Search & Destroy' Search And Destroy; 'This Is Some Rescue' This Is Some Rescue!.

Posted 'Boba Fett In Roadster', 'Bossk In Bus' and 'Zuckuss In Z-Train' dested Boba Fett In Slave I, Bossk In Hound's Tooth and Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Mara's Beatstick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Vader Beatstick' Vader's Lightsaber.
Posted 'Cloud City DB' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (the Dark Cloud City docking bay); 'Death Star DB' Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'Executor DB' Executor: Docking Bay.
Come Here You Big Coward, No Escape and Secret Plans are 2001 Effects (not Reflections III Defensive Shields), counted in the 60.
The strategy mentions the Vegas DPC and the Phoenix I-10 cup but gives no finish for this list; kept as a general deck.
Byline Steve "BlackViper" Marshall; credited to the existing Steve Marshall page (handle BlackViper, as DeckTech 24688).
